beam.architecture:
BeamPredictionLSTMModel(
  (lstm_layers): LSTM(128, 128, batch_first=True)
  (shared_layers): Sequential()
  (output_heads): ModuleList(
    (0-3): 4 x Sequential(
      (0): VectorResBlock(
        (fc1): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=128, bias=False)
        (bn1): BatchNorm1d(128, eps=1e-05, momentum=0.1, affine=True, track_running_stats=True)
        (fc2): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=128, bias=False)
        (bn2): BatchNorm1d(128, eps=1e-05, momentum=0.1, affine=True, track_running_stats=True)
        (relu): ReLU(inplace=True)
      )
      (1): ReLU()
      (2): VectorResBlock(
        (fc1): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=128, bias=False)
        (bn1): BatchNorm1d(128, eps=1e-05, momentum=0.1, affine=True, track_running_stats=True)
        (fc2): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=128, bias=False)
        (bn2): BatchNorm1d(128, eps=1e-05, momentum=0.1, affine=True, track_running_stats=True)
        (relu): ReLU(inplace=True)
      )
      (3): ReLU()
      (4): VectorResBlock(
        (fc1): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=128, bias=False)
        (bn1): BatchNorm1d(128, eps=1e-05, momentum=0.1, affine=True, track_running_stats=True)
        (fc2): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=128, bias=False)
        (bn2): BatchNorm1d(128, eps=1e-05, momentum=0.1, affine=True, track_running_stats=True)
        (relu): ReLU(inplace=True)
      )
      (5): ReLU()
      (6): VectorResBlock(
        (fc1): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=256, bias=False)
        (bn1): BatchNorm1d(128, eps=1e-05, momentum=0.1, affine=True, track_running_stats=True)
        (fc2): Linear(in_features=256, out_features=256, bias=False)
        (bn2): BatchNorm1d(256, eps=1e-05, momentum=0.1, affine=True, track_running_stats=True)
        (relu): ReLU(inplace=True)
        (downsample): Sequential(
          (0): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=256, bias=False)
          (1): BatchNorm1d(256, eps=1e-05, momentum=0.1, affine=True, track_running_stats=True)
        )
      )
    )
  )
)
